Interface ItemAnimation

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ItemAnimation
How an item draws at a point in an animation (7.4.0): given the item, its 16 px box and the animation's progress t, from 0 to 1, it draws the item. The mod picks an animation, runs its progress with a Transition (duration, easing, forward or back), and hands both where an item is drawn, a container screen's slot through SlotItemLooks: 
ItemAnimation look = ItemAnimation.OPEN_LID.posed(t -> new ItemAnimation.Pose(1f - 0.3f * t, 0f, 2f * t));

A mod writes its own as a lambda: draw whatever the item should look like at t (another stack, a sprite, the item with something over it). MenuKit draws the item's count and durability bar after it, where vanilla would, unmoved by the animation.

  • Field Details

    • OPEN_LID

      static final ItemAnimation OPEN_LID
      A box opening, its lid t open: the openness vanilla's own shulker box and chest renderers take, so a shulker box's lid lifts and twists open and a chest's (an ender chest's, a copper one's, a trapped one's) swings up, in whatever model and texture the resource pack gives them. Every other item draws as it is. An open lid stands past the 16 px box, and draws there; to keep it inside, shrink the item with posed(ItemAnimation.Posing).

      default ItemAnimation swapped(UnaryOperator<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack> swap)
      This animation drawing swap's stack in place of the one it is given: another model, another item (7.5.0). The slot's count and durability bar stay the slot's own stack's. swap gets the slot's stack and returns the one to draw.
